cases.prompt: Design the integration between Salesforce and SAP for orders: 50k orders/day, SAP is system of record for pricing, sales reps need near-real-time status.
expected_behavior: States system of record per entity and direction/timing per flow
Separates real-time status (events/CDC) from bulk sync (Bulk API 2.0/middleware)
Idempotency key (External ID + upsert), retry, dead-letter and monitoring
OAuth via External Client App; pinned API version
Mermaid diagram and decision table with at least two options

cases.prompt: We have two business units with different sales processes and a EU data residency requirement for one of them. Single org or multi-org? Record the decision.
expected_behavior: Uses the ADR template with options table including a non-recommended option
Residency treated as a constraint, not a trade-off
